system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: **Rules Injection** (`AGENTS.md` / `.omo/rules/**`) | Both | Project rules and AGENTS.md auto-loaded into the agent's context at every prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent prompts plus runtime rules/AGENTS.md injection and mode prompts (IntentGate).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: **Context Injection**: Auto-inject AGENTS.md, README.md, conditional rules
env_context_strategy.note: Also Explore/Librarian agents and AST-Grep/LSP/grep_app search tools for navigation; hierarchical AGENTS.md from /init-deep.

context_compaction.note: Truncation described as experimental config option; no summarizing condenser documented in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: **Agents**: Sisyphus (the main agent), Prometheus (planner), Oracle (architecture/debugging), Librarian (docs/code search), Explore (fast codebase grep), Multimodal Looker
observation_format.note: Multimodal Looker agent and playwright skill suggest images, but evidence does not show the content conversion; raw_text inferred as default.

tool_call_format.note: Plugin into OpenCode/Codex hosts which use provider tool calling; no parser shown in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: **Hash-anchored Edit Tool** (opt-in via `hashline_edit: true`): `LINE#ID` references validate content before applying every change.
edit_primitive.note: Hashline line-anchored edits are opt-in; default is the host's edit tool (search/replace).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: **Built-in MCPs**: websearch (Exa), context7 (docs), grep_app (GitHub search) — injected at runtime by the plugin

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: 5 built-in MCPs, all slash commands, Team Mode, `/goal`, ultrawork — everything.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Prometheus **interviews you like a real engineer**, identifies scope and ambiguities, and writes a verified plan to `.omo/plans/` before touching code. `/ulw-execute` then starts an **Atlas** work session from that plan.
loop_primitives.note: Default ultrawork loop is react with delegation; hyperplan's 5 hostile critics adds multi-attempt/critique.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: writes a verified plan to `.omo/plans/` before touching code
planning_granularity.note: Also a Todo Enforcer and `/goal` persistent objective.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Sisyphus orchestrates Hephaestus, Oracle, Librarian, Explore. A full AI dev team in parallel.
multi_agent_topology.note: Team Mode (lead + up to 8 members) is opt-in and off by default.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: **Background Agents** | Ultimate | Fire 5+ specialists in parallel. Context stays lean. Results when ready.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Prometheus: - Researches your codebase to understand existing patterns - Asks clarifying questions based on actual findings
human_in_loop.note: Manifesto states human intervention is a failure signal; interview/plan confirmation is the documented gate. Ultrawork mode is fully autonomous.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: **Todo Enforcer** | Ultimate | Agent goes idle? System yanks it back. Your task gets done, period.
short_term_state.note: Todo list plus plan files and `/goal` thread objective persisted.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Skills aren't just prompts. Each brings: - Domain-tuned system instructions. - Embedded MCP servers, on demand.
long_term_memory.note: AGENTS.md / .omo/rules files persist across runs; manifesto mentions 'Caching learnings across sessions'.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Session crash on a Prometheus plan? Resume with `/ulw-execute` (Atlas + boulder). Otherwise use `/handoff` for a new session or `/goal resume` for a paused goal

self_verification.evidence_quote: **`hyperplan`** — 5 hostile agents tear apart your plan from orthogonal angles before a single line of code is written.
self_verification.note: LSP diagnostics feed back automatically; Comment Checker hook; Momus verifies plans.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: One word. Every agent activates. Doesn't stop until done.
retry_policy.note: Todo Enforcer/idle continuation re-drives the agent rather than a fixed attempt count.

rollback.note: Only a git skill for the agent; no harness-level rollback documented in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: **Todo Enforcer** | Ultimate | Agent goes idle? System yanks it back.
termination_condition.note: Idle detection extends rather than ends the run; model-declared completion is the normal terminator.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The agent says what kind of work it needs; the harness picks the right model.
cost_controls.note: Also `fallback_models`; manifesto mentions using cheaper models for simple tasks and caching learnings.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: **Tmux**: Full interactive terminal. REPLs, debuggers, TUI apps. Your agent stays in session.
execution_isolation.note: Runs as a plugin inside OpenCode/Codex on the user's host machine; devcontainer files exist for QA only.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Scoped permissions so agents stay in bounds.
filesystem_access.note: Full host filesystem by default; skills may apply scoped permissions.

network_policy.evidence_quote: **Built-in MCPs** (web/docs/code search) | Ultimate | Exa (web search), Context7 (official docs), Grep.app (GitHub search). Always on.
network_policy.note: No network restriction documented; built-in MCPs require egress.

permission_model.evidence_quote: the installer asks whether to configure Codex for autonomous full-permissions mode
permission_model.note: Autonomous full-permissions recommended; per-agent permission overrides configurable.

tracing.evidence_quote: **Session Tools**: List, read, search, and analyze session history
tracing.note: Anonymous PostHog telemetry on by default (daily-active event only).

replayability.evidence_quote: **Session Recovery**: Automatic recovery from session errors, context window limits, and API failures

eval_hooks.note: Skill eval harness with with_skill/without_skill grading; not a public benchmark runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: **Comment Checker** | Both | No AI slop in comments. Code reads like a senior wrote it.
guardrails.note: 54+ lifecycle hooks incl. IntentGate on prompts (input), comment-checker (output), scoped skill permissions (action).

target_domain.evidence_quote: Oh My OpenAgent is a multi-model agent orchestration harness.
target_domain.note: playwright browser skill exists but core focus is coding.

open_source.note: SUL-1.0 is a source-available custom licence, not confirmed OSI-approved.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Not locked to Claude. Not locked to OpenAI. Not locked to anyone.
